name: Video Probe
description: Analyze video files using a video-capable model. Supports OpenRouter (cloud) and Nemotron Omni via mlx-vlm (local, Apple Silicon).

tools.name: probe_video
tools.title: Probe video
tools.description: Analyze a video file using a video-capable model. Provide the absolute path to a video file and a question about its contents.
promptGuidelines: Use this tool when the user references a video file by path and asks about its content.
Do not guess at video content — always call this tool when visual inspection of a video is needed.
Requires either an OpenRouter API key (cloud) or mlx-vlm running locally (Apple Silicon).

path.description: Absolute path to the video file on disk.

question.description: What to ask or analyze about the video.
